raw_segments.text: They dispersed about the room, reminding me, by the lightness and buoyancy of their movements,
of a flock of white, plumey birds.
Some of them threw themselves in half-reclining positions on the sofas and ottomans.
Some bent over the tables and examined the flowers and books.
The rest gathered in a group round the fire, all talked in a low but clear tone which seemed
I knew their names afterwards and may as well mention them now.
